chunks: With this chain, from al-Hasan, from Abi al-Maghraa', from 'Anbasa ibn Mus'ab, from Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
One who recites Surah Ibrahim and Surah Al-Hijr together in two rak'at on every Friday will never be afflicted with poverty, insanity, or calamity.

key_terms.وَالْحِجْرَ: And Surah Al-Hijr (Chapter 15 of the Quran)

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for reciting Surah Ibrahim and Surah Hijr on Friday?
ai.summary: In Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Thawab al-A’mal*, this hadith highlights the Friday ritual of reciting Surah Ibrahim and Surah Al-Hijr together, linking the themes of divine foundation and resurrection to spiritual and material protection. Shia scholars emphasize that this specific combination safeguards the believer from poverty, insanity, and calamity, reflecting the Surahs' focus on the stability of faith amidst worldly trials. The practice underscores the Shia tradition of assigning specific spiritual benefits to particular Quranic recitations during weekly congregational prayers.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. From the previous chain from al-Hassan from Abi al-Maghraa’ from ’Anbasa b. Mus’ab from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said: “
One who recites Surah Ibrahim and Surah Hijr in two rakats on Friday would never get involved in poverty, insanity and calamity.”
